NONE: › informal used to show that you have not heard or understood something
（表示沒聽清楚或不理解）嗯，啊
› mainly US UK usually eh used at the end of a question or statement, especially when you want someone to agree with what you have said
（用於句尾，尤用於尋求他人的贊同時）嗯

example: "So what do you want to do tonight?" "Huh? What did you say?"
｢那麼今天晚上你想做甚麼？｣ ｢嗯？你說甚麼？｣
Huh? These instructions don't make sense!
Huh, I don't think much of that idea!
哼，我覺得那個主意不怎麼樣！
I'll bet you wish you hadn't done that, huh?
我敢肯定你自己也希望沒做過那件事，嗯？
